title: Open university courses on programming languages, compilers and semantics
description: Openly available university courses (lecture notes, slides, videos, schedules) on programming-language design, semantics, type systems, compilers and program analysis, plus summer schools and MOOCs. Whole-course entries are tagged broadly; individual lecture notes are listed as section entries with concept tags.
